keyboard.title: Keyboard

hero.title: Your clips, where you type
hero.description: UniClip Keyboard shows what you copied on your other devices. Tap a clip to paste it into any app.

almostThere.title: Almost there
almostThere.description: UniClip Keyboard is added. Turn on Full Access so it can show your clips.

fullAccess.title: Allow Full Access
fullAccess.subtitle: So it can show your synced clips
fullAccess.path: Keyboards › UniClip Keyboard › Allow Full Access
fullAccess.readsOnly: Reads only clips UniClip has already synced
fullAccess.sendsOnly: Sends only to devices in your space
fullAccess.systemWarning: iOS shows a general warning when you turn this on.

switch.title: Switch to it once
switch.subtitle: Confirms everything works
switch.instructions: Tap the field, then press and hold the globe key and choose UniClip Keyboard.
switch.placeholder: Tap to bring up the keyboard
switch.detected: Detected, with Full Access. You're all set.
switch.stillOffHint: If the keyboard shows “Full Access Required” instead, Full Access is still off.

keyboard.openSettingsHint: iOS doesn't let apps add keyboards for you. This page updates when you come back.

howToUse.title: How to use
howToUse.switchDescription: In any app, press and hold the globe key and choose UniClip Keyboard.
howToUse.tryPlaceholder: Tap to bring up the keyboard

feedback.title: Key feedback
feedback.footer: Changes take effect the next time you open the keyboard.

systemSettings.footer: Remove the keyboard or turn off Full Access there.

hero.title: Send from any app
hero.description: Share something and pick UniClip. UniClip opens with the item ready, so you choose which devices get it.

quickAccess.title: Quick access
quickAccess.footer: Nothing to switch on. UniClip is in the share sheet as soon as it's installed.
quickAccess.favoritesRowSubtitle: Keep UniClip first in the app row · 4 steps

openSheet.title: Open any share sheet
openSheet.description: Tap Share in any app, or use Open share sheet below to practice with a sample.

findMore.title: Scroll to More
findMore.description: Swipe the row of app icons all the way to the left, then tap More at the end.

addFavorite.title: Add UniClip to Favorites
addFavorite.description: Tap Edit, then the green plus next to UniClip.

moveToTop.title: Move it to the top
moveToTop.description: Drag UniClip by its handle above the others, then tap Done.

package.footer: The ZIP contains redacted app logs, Engine logs, app state, and Share attempt records. Clipboard contents and credentials are excluded.
package.summary: ZIP of the last 3 days, without clipboard content

warning.engineLogsMissing: Engine logs were not found, so the package has no Engine evidence. Restart UniClip and export again.
warning.engineLogsUnreadable: Some or all Engine logs were found but couldn't be read, so the package may be incomplete. Restart UniClip and export again.
warning.engineLogsWrittenNotFound: The Engine reports written logs, but the files are missing from disk. The package is incomplete; restart UniClip and export again.
warning.networkLogsIncomplete: Network logs may be incomplete: some files could not be flushed, read or verified. Only this process was flushed; other processes such as the keyboard were not.

capture.title: Detailed diagnostics
capture.description: Start recording before reproducing the issue, then export logs. Details stay on this device for a capture of up to 10 minutes. Earlier activity is not recovered, and other extensions are not enabled automatically.
capture.failed: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
capture.unavailable: Unavailable until the service is ready.
